$description: Worked compositions built from @kinetixui/iot, and the REAL source file behind each one.
WHY THIS IS NOT blocks.manifest.json. A published Block carries every platform in
components.manifest.json -> platformDefinitions; scripts/check-block-source.mjs enforces that for
status beta / stable / deprecated, and the only escape hatch is status "draft", which
gen-block-examples.mjs leaves out of the website entirely. @kinetixui/iot is a React-only module,
so an IoT composition can be in the Blocks catalogue either untruthfully or invisibly, and neither
is worth having. Rather than weaken the Blocks parity rule — which exists precisely so the
catalogue cannot drift back into a React catalogue with four platforms sprinkled on it — IoT gets
its own layer and states its own scope.
Each entry therefore has ONE `source`, not a `sources` map. The React-only-ness is structural: there
is no field here in which to claim a platform this module does not implement.
scripts/gen-iot-examples.mjs extracts the `kx-iot:start` / `kx-iot:end` region out of each file and
writes the snippets the website shows. The same file renders the live preview, so the code a reader
copies and the composition they are looking at are one artifact rather than two that drift.

state-honesty.title: Requested is not confirmed
state-honesty.description: A live demo of the gap most device UIs hide: what you asked for against what the device reported, through acknowledged, confirmed, failed, timed out and unreachable.

smart-space-environment.title: Smart space environment
smart-space-environment.description: A home end to end: rooms with rolled-up health, light, thermostat, plug and lock controls, air quality, a sample camera frame, energy, alerts and scenes.

agritech-environment.title: Agritech environment
agritech-environment.description: Greenhouse A: climate and soil readings, a soil-moisture trend against its 28% threshold, valve and pump controls with a flaky valve, zones, alerts and the irrigation rule.

operations-environment.title: Operations environment
operations-environment.description: Site 04: fleet health, an Organization to Machine hierarchy with a rollup at every level, equipment health, energy, faults and the command history.

device-detail.title: Device detail
device-detail.description: The flagship: one pump in full, with Overview, Controls, Telemetry, Automations, Activity and Settings tabs, and every command showing requested against confirmed.

automation-builder.title: Automation builder
automation-builder.description: A structured rule editor wired to farm vocabulary, starting from the Zone 3 irrigation rule, with inline validation and a saved-as-demo confirmation.

pairing-flow.title: Pairing flow
pairing-flow.description: Nine steps from choosing a method to done, driven by the package's pairing state machine, with real failure and recovery states.

telemetry-history.title: Telemetry history
telemetry-history.description: Twelve kinds of reading in normal, warning, critical, stale and unavailable states, and trends with a time range, gaps, threshold bands and a data table.

alert-center.title: Alert centre
alert-center.description: Fleet health above an alert list, with an acknowledge flow that keeps acknowledged distinct from resolved.

device-fleet.title: Device overview
device-fleet.description: A fleet at a glance: identity, state, key reading, battery, signal and last contact, worst first.

telemetry-board.title: Telemetry board
telemetry-board.description: Several metrics side by side, including one whose sensor stopped answering.

connection-troubleshooting.title: Connection troubleshooting
connection-troubleshooting.description: The states a device UI usually collapses into one red dot, separated so they can be acted on.

alert-inbox.title: Alert inbox
alert-inbox.description: Severity, device, message and time, with acknowledgement as a state rather than a deletion.

device-dashboard.title: Device dashboard
device-dashboard.description: The full composition: group summary, fleet, telemetry, alerts and activity in one responsive layout.

connected-space.title: Connected space
connected-space.description: Zones, the devices inside one, and the automations that run it — with every command showing the gap between requested and confirmed.
